questions.question: What is the role of the oxide layer in a MOS capacitor??

answers.a: To act as a conductor for charge carriers
answers.b: To provide mechanical support to the structure
answers.c: To serve as an insulating layer between the metal and semiconductor
answers.d: To act as a dopant for the semiconductor

explanations.c: To serve as an insulating layer between the metal and semiconductor

questions.question: Which of the following phenomena is essential to understand before studying a MOS capacitor?
In a MOS capacitor, the accumulation, depletion, and inversion regions are determined by:

answers.a: The applied voltage across the capacitor
answers.b: The thickness of the oxide layer
answers.c: The type of metal used as the gate
answers.d: The doping concentration in the semiconductor

questions.question: Which of the following phenomena is essential to understand before studying a MOS capacitor??
Which property of the semiconductor is primarily modified by doping in a MOS capacitor?
What determines the type of charge carriers (electrons or holes) in a semiconductor?

answers.a: The type of metal used in the MOS capacitor
answers.c: The type and level of doping
answers.d: The thickness of the oxide layer

questions.question: The flat-band condition in a MOS capacitor occurs when:

answers.b: There is no net charge in the semiconductor
answers.d: The energy bands in the semiconductor are bent
